campaign: B (CUSUM K5, m = 5 tail: K1 cells 305-309; 5 open (m, cell) pairs after the theorem-TC lower-front successor)
frozen_before: any route forecast of Campaign B and any certified or real computation of Campaign B
closure_rule: a pair (5, cell) is forecast CLOSED iff the frozen K5-B (k5b_check.k5b_literal, ddd54dc4) passes that cell on the adopted inputs plus the route's forecast enclosures; no other criterion

scenarios.NOMINAL: adopted certified values as recorded; not-yet-measured inputs at their best available estimate, stated in the forecast
scenarios.CONSERVATIVE: as NOMINAL with every not-yet-measured input multiplied by 4 in the unfavourable direction

classes.USEFUL: not STRONG and (CONSERVATIVE closes >= 3/5 or NOMINAL closes 5/5)
classes.INFEASIBLE: NOMINAL closes 0, or the route is ruled out before forecasting

compute_gate.rule: a route whose forecast new-real CPU exceeds the remaining budget is not launched

selection_rule: highest class; among equal classes prefer zero new real addresses, then fewer new-real CPU-hours; below USEFUL is never executed
stop_rule: if every route is MARGINAL or INFEASIBLE, stop Campaign B execution and write a costed continuation plan
no_redefinition: these classes, scenarios and rules are not changed after any forecast or result is seen
